invariants.rationale: The method uses 'layer' extensively without null checks, so it should always be non-null at method exit.
The method returns early if 'layer.getTextureRegion()' is null, thus it must be non-null at method exit.
This is trivially true for any float, but demonstrates that 'getParallaxX()' can always be called at method exit.
Similar for ParallaxY: 'getParallaxY()' is safe to call at method exit since 'layer' is not null.
This demonstrates that 'isRepeatX()' can always be called at method exit; it is not null-guarded but is safe due to non-null 'layer'.
